description: Marion, IA – Liberal U.S. Senate candidate Josh Turek missed hundreds of critical votes – more than 58% of votes during the 2026 legislative session – failing to do his basic duties as a legislator for his constituents. Despite missing hundreds of votes, Turek took the full taxpayer funded per diem of more than $20,000. His excuse for missing hundreds of votes? “It’s the reality of running” a statewide campaign. If the average American didn’t do the core responsibility of their job over half the time, they’d be fired – not promoted. Turek is an absentee legislator and doesn’t deserve the promotion he’s asking for. On Tuesday, March 10th, 2026, Josh Turek skipped the vote to help solve cold cases in Iowa and deliver justice for victims of crime. ###
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ASHLEY FOR IOWA
title: Josh Turek’s Missed Vote of the Day: Helping Solve Cold Cases and Delivering Justice for Victims of Crime - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
